verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the forenoon, that is to say, the first part of the day or all of it,

verses.saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
verses.khattab: and the night when it falls still
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the night when it is still — or [sajā can mean] ‘when it envelops [all] in its darkness’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur raat ki jabke woh sukoon ke saath taari ho jaye

verses.saheeh: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.khattab: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Your Lord has neither forsaken you, He has [not] abandoned you, O Muhammad (s), nor does He hate you: this was revealed when, after the revelation had not come to him for fifteen days, the disbelievers said, ‘His Lord has parted with him and hates him’.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey nabi) tumharey Rubb ne tumko hargiz nahin chodha aur na woh naraaz hua

verses.saheeh: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
verses.khattab: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily the Hereafter shall be better for you, by virtue of the honours awaiting you thereat, than the first [life], this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yaqeenan tumhare liya baad ka daur pehle daur se behtar hai

verses.saheeh: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
verses.khattab: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily your Lord shall give you, in the Hereafter, of good things, a bounteous gift, and you shall be satisfied, with it — and so the Prophet (s) said, ‘In that case, I shall not be satisfied if a single person from among my community remains in the Fire’ (the response to the oath terminates here, with two affirmations and two negations).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur anqareeb tumhra Rubb tumko itna dega ke tum khush ho jaogey

verses.saheeh: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
verses.khattab: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did He not find you an orphan (an interrogative meant as an affirmative, in other words, He did [indeed] find you [an orphan]), having lost your father before you were born or [shortly] thereafter, and shelter you?, by having your uncle Abū Tālib embrace you [as part of his household].
verses.romanUrdu: Kya usne tumko yateem nahin paya aur phir thikana faraham kiya

verses.saheeh: And He found you lost and guided [you],
verses.khattab: Did He not find you unguided then guided you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And did He not find you erring, from the [revealed] Law which you [now] follow, and guided you?, that is, and then guided you to it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhey nawaqif-e-raah paya aur phir hidayat bakshi

verses.saheeh: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
verses.khattab: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And did He not find you needy, poor, and enrich you?, [and] made you content with the spoils and other things which He gave you — in a hadīth [it is stated], ‘Wealth comes not from the proliferation of transient [worldly] goods, but wealth comes from the contentedness of the soul’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhein nadaar(in want) paya aur phir maldar kar diya

verses.saheeh: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
verses.khattab: So do not oppress the orphan
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So, as for the orphan, do not oppress [him], by appropriating his wealth or otherwise,
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza yateem par sakhti na karo

verses.saheeh: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and as for the beggar, do not drive [him] away, [do not] repel him on account of his poverty,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur saayil(maangne waley) ko na jhidko

verses.saheeh: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
verses.khattab: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and as for your Lord’s grace, to you, by way of prophethood and otherwise, proclaim [it], make it known. The omission in certain instances of the [suffixed] pronoun referring to the Prophet (s) from the end of the verbs is intended to sustain the end-rhyme of the verses.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur apne Rubb ki niyamt ka izhar karo
